ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 65-70% of the visible surface area, primarily in the central and lower-medial sections, while low-intensity (black) pixels define the trailing edges, distal tips, and localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions occupy the central-basal area of both lobes. These are bounded by a continuous black perimeter along the trailing edge. Distinct circular black mottling is mapped to the mid-lateral section of the left lobe, while the right lobe contains more vertical linear dark streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable amplitude. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits several deep, irregular U-shaped notches (tissue voids), while the left lobe shows a more consistent, low-amplitude sawtooth topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer edges exhibit a convex leading trajectory that tapers into sharp, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical trailing edge morphology characterized by deep primary notches on the right lobe versus minor serrations on the left.
